{{Top}}
[[File:Dead_Man_Switch_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|Deadman's switch]]
A '''deadman switch''', or '''deadman's switch''', was a device installed on certain [[Swoop/Legends|swoops]] in the grips. When it detected that the swoop's [[Swooper/Legends|rider]] was no longer present, it would disable the swoop's [[Turbine/Legends|turbine]], though not the [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor engine]].<ref name="SotE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

Such devices were also sometimes found on [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. If one were to let go of the thermal detonator without first disarming this switch, it would go off. If the deadman's switch was not used, the device would run on a [[timer]] instead.<ref name="SotE" />
